visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman stands in an outdoor urban garden setting with lush green bushes behind her. She wears a white ringer-style T-shirt layered under a long black slip dress, accessorized with black over-ear headphones and a watch. She holds a large black tote bag with a blue bear plush charm. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting her friendly facial expression. (2) The woman performs a full 360-degree twirl to showcase the flow and back of her black dress against the backdrop of a textured gray stone wall and green plants. She smiles at the camera as she completes the turn, holding the bag out slightly to emphasize her silhouette. (3) A medium close-up shot focuses on the woman's profile, showing a small cartoon sticker on her black over-ear headphones. She smiles softly and points to the sticker with her index finger, emphasizing the personalized detail of her tech accessory. (4) The camera shifts to a close-up of the black tote bag. The woman's hands adjust the blue Care Bear-style plush charm attached to the handle. The charm has a transparent belly containing small blue glittery elements, and her hands gently shake the bag to show the movement. (5) The woman sits on a low wooden bench against a stone wall. She picks up a white paper coffee cup with a brown logo and takes a sip, looking away from the camera in a relaxed pose. A black bag sits on the bench beside her.
